geographicCandidates.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing / Ch’ał outcrop
geographicCandidates.description: NASA lists Ha’ahóni (Sol 371) and Atsá (Sol 377) as rock-core samples collected at this named sampling location. The public inventory provides no geographic coordinates for the region or its individual sample sites. Candidate only; not a registered route waypoint and not a claim that either sample lies within the eventual crop.
